'If you control a Hyper Driver, this costs {r} less to play. / Boost' -- Boost is printed and fires from the card DB.

A COST REDUCTION IS A COST, so it lives in card-level `cost_modifiers`, which play.py consults when deciding legality and price; as an ON_PLAY effect it would apply after the price was already paid. CONTROLS_TOKEN_TYPE takes `token` SINGULAR -- the plural spelling is unread and the condition would be false in every state.
